title: Integration Ops Standup — Closed-Loop Notes (2026-06-18)
content:
Meeting: Integration Ops weekly standup — closed-loop review
Date: 2026-06-18
Time: 10:00am PT (30m)
Attendees: Anika (owner), Liam O'Connor, Priya Shah, Jorge Mendes, Sofia Nguyen, external: Zymera eng lead (B. Chen)
Absentees: N/A

Purpose: quick sync across Solutions + ProServices to surface integration status for active customers, close stale action items, escalate blockers that need SRE/infra support. This doc is intentionally terse — capture decisions and owners.

Quick wins / highlights
- Zymera Health: initial inference throughput validation completed on dedicated pool; avg p95 latency 190ms for 2k token tests — meets target for staging.
- KitePayments: schema validation for event webhook completed; sample payloads accepted in sandbox, retry logic updated.
- StratoMedia: demo day yesterday — no regressions reported on chat flows; UX asks collected and filed.

Customer status (one-line + blockers + owner)
1) Zymera Health — Status: green->yellow (picked up perf regressions earlier; now retested)
   - Progress: Dedicated slot provisioned + model pinned to rwd-v1.3-quant; canary passed 3/3 days.
   - Blockers: cost projection still TBD for scale; finance asked for 90-day run-rate estimate (PROSERV-8813).
   - Owner: Anika / Liaison: B. Chen (Zymera)
   - Next steps: Jorge to run 48h soak test (longer sequences) starting 6/20; deliver cost estimate by 6/25.

2) KitePayments — Status: yellow
   - Progress: Webhook schema done; local test harness wired to sandbox. PR for retry framework merged (gh: redwood/proxy#421).
   - Blockers: Intermittent 502s on outbound to bank simulator under high QPS — appears networking transient on dedicated infra. Need infra trace.
   - Owner: Priya (integration lead)
   - Next steps: Priya to open OPS-1298 and tag SRE; if not resolved by 6/21 escalate to infra oncall.

3) StratoMedia — Status: green
   - Progress: Demo feedback consolidated. Two UX asks turned into tickets. No major infra needs.
   - Blockers: none critical. Scheduling rollback window for a prompt-tuning tweak 6/22 as requested.
   - Owner: Liam O'Connor

4) FinEdge (new onboarding) — Status: red
   - Progress: initial security review waiting on customer SOC2 artifacts; can't schedule private deployment until OK.
   - Blockers: security docs outstanding + internal compliance review backlog.
   - Owner: Sofia Nguyen / Support: CISO team
   - Next steps: Sofia to push compliance queue with Product Security and share timeline by EOD 6/19.

Open action items (closed-loop)
- PROSERV-8813 (Zymera cost estimate): Jorge to complete 6/25. [OPEN]
- OPS-1298 (KitePayments 502 tracing): Priya to create and add logs/traces, tag SRE. [OPEN]
- GH PR redwood/proxy#421 (retry framework): merged; rollout checklist in progress. Liam to run canary on staging 6/19. [IN PROGRESS]
- Security docs for FinEdge: Sofia to chase CISO + customer; update Confluence page with expected ETA 6/19. [OPEN]
- Close stale ticket PROSERV-752 (old Strato content migration): Anika to confirm archival by 6/21. [OPEN]

Escalations / requests to SRE/Infra
- Infra: need packet capture and eBPF flame for KitePayments 6/17 14:00 events (sample timeframe) — Priya added initial traces but SRE asked for deeper capture. Please assign on OPS-1298.
- Infra: request cost-sim environment (lower priority) to run 72h model-run cost projections for high-TPS workloads (Zymera). Jorge will provide workload profile.

Decisions made in meeting
- For Zymera, we will keep rwd-v1.3-quant pinned until soak completes; no automatic fallbacks for production until finance commits to budget threshold. Decision owner: Anika.
- KitePayments: short-term mitigation is to lower max concurrency at proxy layer to 60% for outbound bank simulator calls; Priya to implement on staging and report. If 502s persist, route to fallback gateway.

Meeting notes / granular log (choppy)
- 10:02am: quick round-robin updates. Zymera reported better p95; still want long-run tests.
- 10:07am: Priya shows sandbox logs; 502s correlate with bursts after retries; need SRE to surface packet drops.
- 10:12am: Jorge notes quantization path may have edge-case when seq>3k tokens; plan to push sequence-limited tests.
- 10:16am: Sofia asks about compliance checklist; we confirmed product-security has open review PR. Sofia to escalate.
- 10:22am: Liam closes with Strato follow-ups; UX tickets created (PROSERV-8830, PROSERV-8831).

Risks and mitigation (short)
- Risk: finance delay blocks Zymera GA -> mitigation: provide 30/60/90 day cost buckets and recommended throttles; sales can present options to customer.
- Risk: persistent 502s for KitePayments -> mitigation: add proxy-level backoff and fallbacks; SRE deep trace; potential temporary throughput cap.

Unresolved questions / parking lot
- Do we require a new quantization profile for Zymera's long-sequence workload? (owner: Research/Applied ML)
- Who signs off on non-prod SOC2 evidence for FinEdge? (parking for legal + security)

Next sync / cadence
- Weekly on Thursdays 10:00am PT. Next meeting 2026-06-25.
- Quick mid-week async checkpoint if OPS-1298 escalates (Priya to ping #proservices-integration).

Action item table (Owner | Action | Due | Status)
- Jorge | Run 48h soak test for Zymera (long sequences) | 2026-06-20 | OPEN
- Priya | Create OPS-1298 with packet capture and tag SRE; implement proxy concurrency cap on staging | 2026-06-21 | OPEN
- Liam | Canary rollout for retry framework redwood/proxy#421 | 2026-06-19 | IN PROGRESS
- Sofia | Follow up with Product Security + customer for FinEdge SOC2 artifacts; update confluence | 2026-06-19 | OPEN
- Anika | Archive PROSERV-752 or confirm retention policy | 2026-06-21 | OPEN

Notes to self / miscellaneous (choppy)
- Push summary to Confluence page and then paste quick link in #proservices-integration.
- Remind sales ops to collect expected transaction volumes for Zymera next week.
- Keep the closed-loop cadence tight: any item open > 7 days should have an escalation owner.

End of doc.
